_note: 學習路徑內容建置第3批 #4／6：情態助動詞 should / ought to（eng.t_mid.modal.should-ought，會考級）。should + 原形＝勸告建議（You should drink more water）、shouldn't＝不建議、ought to 同義且保留 to、should 後接原形。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix shd_）。

units.title_zh: should 與 ought to（勸告建議）
units.can_do: 我能用 should + 原形給建議（You should drink more water）、用 shouldn't 勸人別做某事，並知道 ought to 意思跟 should 一樣但保留 to（You ought to apologize）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'should' + base verb is used to give advice or a recommendation — to say what is a good idea: You look tired; you should go to bed early. You should drink more water.
claims.verification_ref: should 表建議/勸告（好主意）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'should not' (shouldn't) advises against something — says it is not a good idea: You shouldn't eat candy before bed.
claims.verification_ref: shouldn't 勸阻（不是好主意）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'ought to' + base verb means almost the same as 'should' (give advice), but 'ought' always keeps 'to': You ought to apologize. We ought to leave early.
claims.verification_ref: ought to 與 should 同義（建議），ought 保留 to；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'should' is a modal verb, so it is followed by the base form of the verb — no 'to' and no '-s': She should eat more vegetables (not 'should to eat' or 'should eats').
claims.verification_ref: should 後接原形（無 to、無 -s）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Use should to give advice or to say that something is a good idea. should is a modal verb, so after it use the base form of the verb, with no to and no -s. It is softer than must - it is advice, not a strict rule.
teach.zh_hint: 給別人建議、說「這樣做比較好」時用 should。should 是情態助動詞，後面直接接動詞原形，不加 to、不加 -s。它比 must 溫和——是建議，不是硬性規定。

teach.body: You look tired. You should go to bed early. You should drink more water.
teach.zh_hint: 你看起來很累，你應該早點睡、多喝水。should + 原形。

teach.body: To advise someone not to do something, use should not (short form shouldn't). It means that it is not a good idea.
teach.zh_hint: 勸別人「別做某事」用 should not，縮寫 shouldn't，表示那不是好主意。

teach.body: You shouldn't eat candy before bed; it is bad for your teeth.
teach.zh_hint: 睡前你不該吃糖，對牙齒不好。shouldn't＝勸阻。

teach.body: ought to means almost the same as should and is also used for advice, but after ought you must keep to before the base form: ought to + base form. For example: You ought to apologize.
teach.zh_hint: ought to 的意思跟 should 幾乎一樣，也是給建議，但 ought 後面一定要保留 to，再接原形：ought to + 原形。例如 You ought to apologize.（你應該道歉。）

teach.body: You were rude to her. You ought to apologize.
teach.zh_hint: 你對她很沒禮貌，你應該道歉。ought to + 原形。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：I have a bad toothache. — You ____ see a dentist.（我牙齒很痛。—你應該去看牙醫。給建議）

distractor_rationales.should to: should 後面直接接原形，沒有 to；應是 should see。
distractor_rationales.to should: 語序錯了，而且 should 前面不加 to；應是 You should see。

practice.feedback: 給建議用 should + 原形：You should see a dentist。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：You ____ eat candy before bed; it is bad for your teeth.（睡前你不該吃糖，對牙齒不好。勸阻）

distractor_rationales.should: should eat candy 是「應該吃糖」，意思相反；這裡是勸你別吃。
distractor_rationales.don't should: 情態助動詞 should 的否定直接加 not（shouldn't），不用 don't。
distractor_rationales.shouldn't to: shouldn't 後面直接接原形 eat，沒有 to。

practice.feedback: 勸人別做某事用 shouldn't：You shouldn't eat candy before bed。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：You were rude to her. You ____ apologize.（你對她很沒禮貌，你應該道歉。用 ought）

distractor_rationales.ought: ought 要保留 to 再接原形；應是 ought to apologize。
distractor_rationales.ought for: ought 後面接的是 to，不是 for。
distractor_rationales.should to: should 後面不加 to（這是 should 和 ought 的差別）；若用 should 應是 should apologize。

practice.feedback: ought 要保留 to：ought to + 原形（ought to apologize）。

practice.stem: 填入正確的動詞形式：She should ____ more vegetables.（她應該多吃蔬菜。）

distractor_rationales.eats: should 後面不加 -s，就算主詞是 She 也用原形 eat。
distractor_rationales.to eat: should 後面不加 to，直接接原形 eat。
distractor_rationales.eating: should 後面接原形，不是 -ing 形式。

practice.feedback: should 後面一定接原形：She should eat（不是 should to eat／should eats）。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：It's going to rain. You ____ take an umbrella.（要下雨了，你應該帶把傘。給建議）

distractor_rationales.shouldn't: shouldn't take 是「不該帶」，意思相反；下雨應該帶傘。
distractor_rationales.should to: should 後面直接接原形，沒有 to。

practice.feedback: 給建議用 should + 原形：You should take an umbrella。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: You should drink more water, and you ought to get more sleep.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：should 和 ought to（記得 to）有沒有寫對，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。兩句都是陳述句，句尾自然下收；ought to 連著唸成順口的 /ɔːt tə/。

lines.text: You ought to apologize to her.
lines.intonation: 平穩、ought to 連讀、句尾下收
